name: Thaff Restaurant
area: Canal side near YMCA, Alappuzha town
signature_dish: Meen pollichathu — fish cooked spicy in a banana-leaf wrap
why_it_matters: Widely named the best all-round restaurant in Alleppey town — a place equally popular with locals and travellers for Keralan seafood and Arabic-leaning bites. The kitchen handles both sea and backwater fish, and the meen pollichathu is the dish reviewers come back for. Originally on Mullackal Road, it has since moved to the canal side next to the YMCA.
insider_tip: There is a downstairs hall and a plusher AC room upstairs — same menu, same prices. Order the meen pollichathu for the banana-leaf fish and the podimeen fry as a side. A meal runs roughly ₹150-250.
signature_address: Thaff Restaurant, canal side near YMCA, Alappuzha, Kerala 688001

name: Halais Restaurant
signature_dish: Chicken biryani — often called the best biryani in Alleppey
why_it_matters: A bustling Mullackal Road biryani-and-Arabic house in central Alleppey, Halais is the town's go-to for biryani — reviewers repeatedly call it the best in Alleppey — alongside Indian, Chinese and Arabic dishes at reasonable rates. It is a locals' favourite for an everyday biryani-and-shawarma dinner.
insider_tip: Go for the chicken biryani and a shawarma plate; the Arabic side is stronger than the Chinese. It is a busy, casual room — quick service, polite staff. Cash and UPI.
signature_address: Halais Restaurant, Mullackal Road, Alappuzha, Kerala 688011

name: Cassia Restaurant
signature_dish: Alleppey fish curry made with locally sourced fresh fish
why_it_matters: A spacious, well-known multi-cuisine restaurant in the heart of Alappuzha city — one of the town's most popular sit-down options with both travellers and locals, around 4.0 on TripAdvisor across thousands of reviews. Strong on Kerala-style seafood, especially the Alleppey fish curry, plus Indian, Chinese and Continental pages. A second outlet sits on NH-47 at Kommady.
insider_tip: The non-veg Kerala meals are the pick — locals describe them as homely. Skip the dosas, which are weaker. Open early to late (around 7.30am-9.45pm), so it works for breakfast through dinner.

name: Indian Coffee House
signature_dish: Filter coffee and masala dosa served by the cooperative's turbaned waiters
why_it_matters: The Alappuzha branch of the worker-cooperative Indian Coffee House — a Mullackal Road institution near the boat jetty, seating around 100 with a separate family section. South Indian breakfast staples, fluffy appam and the signature strong filter coffee, served the unchanging ICH way.
insider_tip: A cheap, reliable breakfast or tea-time stop before the morning houseboat departures from the jetty. Order appam with the curry of the day and a filter coffee. Cash preferred.
signature_address: Indian Coffee House, 1st floor Naz Complex, Mullackal Road, Alappuzha, Kerala 688011

name: KR Bakers
signature_dish: Chicken puffs and bakery snacks from the Kerala bakery chain
why_it_matters: A branch of KR Bakes, a Kerala-and-Tamil-Nadu bakery chain with around a dozen outlets. In Alleppey it is an everyday tea-time stop for chicken puffs, cutlets, cakes and bakery snacks — the cheap, fast option for a snack before or after a houseboat trip.
insider_tip: Treat it as a grab-and-go bakery rather than a sit-down meal — the puffs and cutlets are freshest in the late afternoon. Cash and UPI.
